title: Cotopaxi adopts a drop strategy to build buzz ahead of BFCM
description: Cotopaxi is releasing new products every other day, from Nov. 1-11, through a campaign it's calling "Cotodays." It's part of the brand's plan to build awareness ahead of the crowded Black Friday/Cyber Monday period.

description: The brand returned to growth in Q3 compared to its weak results last year, thanks largely to wholesale revenue from retail partners.

title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart in $17 billion grocery delivery deal
description:
DoorDash Inc. announced a deal to acquire its last-mile delivery rival Instacart in a deal valued at $17 billion. The combined company would unite operations from two of the most active platforms in retail and grocery delivery services through a transaction subject to approval by regulators and Instacart shareholders.
